messages:
incident-bot: P0 detected — spike in 5xx for hosted text-gen (us-east-1). Pager sent to maya. War room: https://meet.redwood/warrooms/4440001234

maya: Ack'd — joining war room now :raised_hand:

liam: joining. I'll start with routing/nginx and model shard health checks.

sophie: pinging support for customer comms draft, @raj @kelly please standby.

maya: quick findings: autoscaler healthy, but one dedicated GPU pool has repeated container restarts + OOM traces. Pods are flapping and causing request failures.

liam: seeing repeated KV cache errors in runtime logs, snippet:

```
ERROR kv_cache: eviction failed key=abc123 ttl=-1
Stack: runtime/kv.go:241
```

maya: owner = maya (oncall). Immediate mitigations: (1) scale dedicated-pool-7 by +2 nodes, (2) enable fallback routing to model=v1-small for new sessions, (3) throttle new session rate to 0.8. Who can draft status update?

raj: Drafting short statuspage blurb now:
"We are investigating a disruption affecting Hosted Text Generation in US‑East. Some requests are returning 5xx errors. Engineers are actively mitigating; a temporary fallback and scaling actions are in progress. Next update in 15 minutes."

maya: add workaround: "Customers may retry or switch to region=us-west or model=v1-small temporarily."

sophie: added workaround line. Ready to publish pending confirmations. @liam @maya please review.

liam: LGTM. The fallback routing is already queued.

maya: LGTM — go ahead and publish.

incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/4440001234 (published by sophie)

kelly: Sending customer notifications to top-tier contacts now with the above message + ETA note.

sophie: Customer comms copy for channel: "We're aware of elevated error rates for text generation in US‑East. Our engineers are mitigating; recommended workaround: retry or route to US‑West / use model=v1-small. We'll update within 15 minutes."

kelly: sent to customers, some asked for ETA — replying: "High priority, estimated mitigation window 30–60 minutes; will confirm sooner if resolved."

liam: metrics update — 5xx rate peaked ~9% and is down to ~3% after scale + fallback started. Watching latency and success rate.

maya: ops note: rate throttle applied to new sessions at 0.8 to reduce burst pressure. Monitoring memory/eviction OOMs on the problematic pool.

raj: updating incident timeline and recording all mitigation steps. Will prepare post‑mortem template once stabilized.

sophie: tentative root cause: KV cache eviction regression after recent runtime GC tuning — hypothesis only until post‑mortem.

maya: agree on hypothesis, keep that as "investigating" in timeline.

kelly: customers acknowledged, two requested more frequent updates — will push next update in 10.

maya: I'm staying as incident owner for the next 30m, will handoff if needed. If we regress, ping me directly @maya.

liam: monitoring dashboards look stable, continuing to watch for error bursts.

incident-bot: Reminder: next scheduled status update in 10 minutes.

maya: Latest for now — proceeding to validate long‑term fixes. Will update thread in 10. :eyes:
